summary: Web pages gain fuller CSS Typed OM support for transforms and ML-KEM in WebCrypto, a post-quantum cryptography building block. SpeechRecognition and Permissions Policy also get updates, including the move from the old Feature-Policy name to Permissions-Policy and standardized structured-header parsing. Speculation Rules can now prefetch more likely destinations on hover or pointerdown while avoiding redundant requests, which can help pages load sooner without wasting network traffic. Firefox also tightens security and compatibility behavior around CSP, mixed content, content-policy blocking, cookies, and cross-origin speech, alongside behind-the-scenes improvements to canvas cleanup, scrolling, and printing.
